title: Axis Privilege annual fee waiver on anniversary-year spend

conditions.value: INR 5,00,000 of qualifying spend in a card anniversary year

exclusions: The stated spend threshold excludes utility and telecom, rent, wallet, government services, insurance, gold and jewellery, fuel, and educational services.
The quantity records the spend a cardholder must reach, not a sum they receive; the benefit is the fee not being charged.
No automated redemption authorization is implied.
redemption_steps: Reach the stated spend in a card anniversary year, counting only qualifying categories.
The annual fee is waived rather than refunded.
